places.name: Aconcagua Provincial Park
places.ai_summary: Home to the highest peak in the Americas, Aconcagua Provincial Park offers breathtaking Andean scenery. Popular for trekking (permits required for longer routes), mountaineering, and scenic viewpoints accessible by car, like Laguna Horcones.

opening_hours.mon: Park open seasonally (approx Nov-Mar); access/hours vary
opening_hours.tue: Park open seasonally (approx Nov-Mar); access/hours vary
opening_hours.wed: Park open seasonally (approx Nov-Mar); access/hours vary
opening_hours.thu: Park open seasonally (approx Nov-Mar); access/hours vary
opening_hours.fri: Park open seasonally (approx Nov-Mar); access/hours vary
opening_hours.sat: Park open seasonally (approx Nov-Mar); access/hours vary
opening_hours.sun: Park open seasonally (approx Nov-Mar); access/hours vary
opening_hours.notes: Check official park website for season dates, hours, fees, and permit info

places.best_time_to_visit: Summer (Dec–Feb) for hiking/climbing; shoulder seasons for views
places.place_tip: Located ~3 hours drive from Mendoza city. Acclimatize to altitude. Bring layers, sun protection, water. Check road conditions.
places.address: Ruta Nacional 7, Las Heras, Mendoza, Argentina

places.name: Plaza Independencia
places.ai_summary: Mendoza's largest central square, featuring fountains, sculptures, green spaces, and the underground Municipal Museum of Modern Art (MMAMM). A social hub and good starting point for exploring downtown.

opening_hours.notes: Public square; check MMAMM hours separately

places.place_tip: Relax by the fountains, check out the museum if interested in modern art. Surrounded by four smaller plazas (España, Italia, Chile, San Martín).
places.address: Plaza Independencia, Mendoza City, Mendoza, Argentina

places.name: Parque General San Martín
places.ai_summary: A vast urban park designed by landscape architect Carlos Thays. Features a large lake, the Cerro de la Gloria monument, museums, a rose garden (Rosedal), and extensive green areas for recreation.

opening_hours.notes: Public park; check hours for museums, Cerro de la Gloria access, etc.

places.place_tip: Rent a boat on the lake, walk or cycle the paths, visit the Cerro de la Gloria for city views (accessible by car or foot).
places.sunset_time: Good from Cerro de la Gloria
places.address: Parque General San Martín, Mendoza City, Mendoza, Argentina

places.name: Wine Tours in Maipú & Luján de Cuyo
places.ai_summary: Explore Mendoza's primary wine regions, Maipú and Luján de Cuyo, known for Malbec. Tours often involve visiting multiple 'bodegas' (wineries) for tastings, vineyard walks, and learning about winemaking. Options range from guided bus tours to self-guided cycling.

opening_hours.notes: Advance reservation highly recommended for specific wineries/tours

places.place_tip: Book winery visits in advance. Consider hiring a driver, taxi, or joining a tour for tastings. Cycling is popular but requires planning (bike rentals available).
places.name_english: Wine Tours In Maipu & Lujan De Cuyo
places.sunset_time: Possible at some wineries with views
places.address: Maipú / Luján de Cuyo, Mendoza Province, Argentina
places.name_native: Ruta del Vino Maipú & Luján de Cuyo

places.name: Bodega Catena Zapata
places.ai_summary: One of Argentina's most famous and highly regarded wineries, known for pioneering high-altitude Malbec. Features a distinctive pyramid-like winery building inspired by Mayan architecture. Offers premium tours and tastings.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking essential, often weeks/months ahead

places.place_tip: Book well in advance due to high demand. Premium experience with a focus on high-quality wines.
places.address: Cobos s/n, Agrelo, Luján de Cuyo, Mendoza, Argentina

places.name: Bodega Trapiche
places.ai_summary: One of Argentina's largest and most recognized wine producers, located in Maipú. Features a historic building with modern winemaking facilities. Offers various tour and tasting options, often including their extensive portfolio.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking recommended

places.place_tip: Good option for seeing a large-scale, historic winery. Book tours online. Located conveniently in Maipú.
places.address: Nueva Mayorga s/n, M5521 Maipú, Mendoza, Argentina

places.name: Museo del Área Fundacional
places.ai_summary: Museum located at the site of Mendoza's original founding, destroyed by an earthquake in 1861. Showcases archaeological remains of the old Cabildo (town hall) and Jesuit church, plus exhibits on the city's history.

opening_hours.notes: Hours can vary, especially the afternoon break; verify locally

places.place_tip: Provides context for Mendoza's history and the impact of the 1861 earthquake. Located near Plaza Pedro del Castillo.
places.address: Alberdi y Videla Castillo, Mendoza City, Mendoza, Argentina

places.name: Cerro de la Gloria Monument
places.ai_summary: Hill within Parque General San Martín crowned by a large, dramatic monument dedicated to San Martín's Army of the Andes. Offers panoramic views of Mendoza city and the surrounding Andes foothills.

opening_hours.notes: Can drive or walk up; check if road access is open/hours for monument base access

places.best_time_to_visit: Clear days for best views, late afternoon/sunset
places.place_tip: Popular spot for sunset views over the city. Can be reached by car, tour bus, or a strenuous walk up from the park.
places.address: Cerro de la Gloria, Parque General San Martín, Mendoza, Argentina

places.name: Puente del Inca
places.ai_summary: A natural arch bridge over the Las Cuevas River in the Andes, known for its colorful mineral deposits from thermal springs. Site of former thermal baths (ruins remain). Located along Route 7 towards Chile, near Aconcagua Park.

opening_hours.notes: Natural landmark; viewing platforms accessible, respect barriers

places.best_time_to_visit: Year-round (weather permitting, road access can close in winter)
places.place_tip: Popular stop on the high mountain route (Alta Montaña) from Mendoza. Be prepared for high altitude and potentially cold/windy conditions. Small market stalls nearby sell souvenirs.
places.address: Puente del Inca, Ruta Nacional 7, Mendoza, Argentina

places.name: Cacheuta Hot Springs
places.ai_summary: Thermal hot springs resort area located in the Andean foothills near Mendoza. Offers various options from a public water park (Parque de Agua) to a more exclusive hotel & spa with thermal pools and treatments.

opening_hours.mon: Varies (Water park/Spa hours differ, check website)
opening_hours.notes: Check official website for Parque de Agua vs Hotel/Spa hours, days of operation, and booking requirements

places.place_tip: Decide between the family-friendly water park or the more relaxed spa experience (often adults-only or restricted hours). Booking is recommended for both, essential for the spa.
places.cost: Paid (different fees for water park vs spa)
places.address: Ruta Provincial 82, km 38, Cacheuta, Luján de Cuyo, Mendoza, Argentina

places.name: Villavicencio Natural Reserve
places.ai_summary: Private nature reserve known for its historic hotel (currently closed for lodging but visible), scenic mountain drive (Ruta Provincial 52) with numerous hairpin turns ('Caracoles'), and natural springs providing bottled water. Offers wildlife viewing and mountain landscapes.

opening_hours.mon: Check website (often daily access to drive/ viewpoints, hours vary)
opening_hours.notes: Access times and fees can vary seasonally; hotel access may be restricted or part of specific tours

places.best_time_to_visit: Year-round (weather permitting for drive, can be hot in summer)
places.place_tip: The drive up the 'Caracoles' offers great views but requires careful driving on unpaved sections. Check road conditions. Good spot for seeing guanacos.
places.advanced_booking: Not usually required for drive; check for specific activities/tours
places.cost: Paid (entrance fee usually applies for reserve access/drive)
places.address: Ruta Provincial 52, Las Heras, Mendoza, Argentina

places.name: Museo Nacional del Vino y la Vendimia
places.ai_summary: National Wine and Harvest Museum located in Maipú, housed in a historic chalet (Casa Gargantini). Exhibits cover the history of winemaking in the region, vineyard tools, and the cultural significance of the grape harvest festival (Vendimia).

opening_hours.notes: Hours can be variable, confirm locally, especially Saturday afternoons

places.place_tip: Good stop in Maipú for context on the local wine industry's history before or after visiting bodegas.
places.name_english: National Museum of Wine and Harvest
places.address: Ozamis 914, M5515 Maipú, Mendoza, Argentina

places.name: Uspallata Valley Drive
places.ai_summary: Scenic drive through the Uspallata Valley along Route 7 (part of the Alta Montaña route). Known for its dramatic, colorful rock formations, high-altitude desert landscapes, and connection to pre-Columbian history and San Martín's Andean crossing.

opening_hours.notes: Public road; check conditions, especially in winter

places.place_tip: Stop at viewpoints to appreciate the landscape. Uspallata town offers services. Can be combined with visits to Puente del Inca and Aconcagua.
places.address: Ruta Nacional 7, Uspallata Valley, Mendoza, Argentina

places.name: Potrerillos Lake
places.ai_summary: Large reservoir/dam on the Mendoza River, located in the Andean foothills. Popular for water sports (windsurfing, kayaking, rafting on nearby river sections), fishing, and enjoying mountain scenery. Several small towns and accommodation options surround the lake.

opening_hours.notes: Public area; activity providers have own hours

places.best_time_to_visit: Year-round (water sports best in warmer months)
places.place_tip: Good spot for a scenic stop between Mendoza city and the higher Andes. Can be windy, ideal for windsurfing. Rafting outfitters operate nearby.
places.address: Dique Potrerillos, Ruta Nacional 7 / Ruta Provincial 82, Mendoza, Argentina

places.name: Los Penitentes Ski Resort
places.ai_summary: Smaller ski resort located on Route 7 in the high Andes, closer to Aconcagua than Mendoza city. Offers skiing and snowboarding in winter. Less extensive than Cerro Catedral in Bariloche.

opening_hours.notes: Check official status; resort operations have been intermittent/closed in recent years. Verify before planning.

places.place_tip: **Verify operational status before visiting.** Historically offered slopes near the main highway.
places.address: Los Penitentes, Ruta Nacional 7, Mendoza, Argentina

places.name: Cordón del Plata Range Hike
places.ai_summary: Mountain range near Mendoza offering various hiking and mountaineering opportunities, from day hikes to multi-day climbs on peaks over 5000-6000m. Popular base is Vallecitos. Requires preparation for high altitude and mountain conditions.

opening_hours.notes: Mountain environment; requires experience or guide for serious treks

places.place_tip: Only suitable for experienced hikers/mountaineers or guided groups for significant treks. Altitude acclimatization is crucial. Day hikes possible at lower elevations.
places.address: Cordón del Plata, Luján de Cuyo, Mendoza, Argentina

places.name: Plaza España
places.ai_summary: One of the four smaller squares surrounding Plaza Independencia in Mendoza city. Known for its Spanish-influenced design, featuring colourful tiles (azulejos), fountains, and monuments.

opening_hours.notes: Public square

places.place_tip: Pleasant spot for a short break while exploring the city center. Notice the detailed tilework.
places.address: Plaza España, Mendoza City, Mendoza, Argentina

places.name: Chacras de Coria Village
places.ai_summary: Charming village/suburb just south of Mendoza city, located within the Luján de Cuyo wine region. Known for its tree-lined streets, relaxed atmosphere, boutique wineries, good restaurants, and artisan shops.

opening_hours.notes: Village atmosphere; check hours for specific wineries/restaurants

places.place_tip: Good base for exploring Luján de Cuyo wineries. Pleasant to walk or cycle around. Has a popular Sunday artisan market in the main plaza.
places.address: Chacras de Coria, Luján de Cuyo, Mendoza, Argentina

places.name: Andes Mountain Day Trip
places.ai_summary: General term for tours or self-drives heading west from Mendoza city into the Andes along Route 7 (Alta Montaña route). Common stops include Potrerillos, Uspallata, Puente del Inca, viewpoints near Aconcagua, and sometimes the border with Chile.

opening_hours.notes: Public road; check conditions, especially in winter. Tour timings vary.

places.best_time_to_visit: Year-round (check road conditions, summer best for high passes)
places.place_tip: Bring layers as altitude and weather change rapidly. Sun protection and water are essential. Consider altitude effects. Guided tours handle logistics.
places.address: Ruta Nacional 7 (West of Mendoza), Mendoza, Argentina

places.name: Ruta del Vino Cycling Tour
places.ai_summary: Popular way to explore wineries, particularly in Maipú. Numerous rental shops offer bikes, and relatively flat roads connect many bodegas. Allows for self-paced visits and tastings.

opening_hours.notes: Winery hours vary, book visits in advance

places.place_tip: Plan your route and winery stops in advance (booking essential). Stay hydrated. Be mindful of wine consumption and cycling safety. Maipú is popular for this.
places.address: Maipú / Luján de Cuyo, Mendoza, Argentina
